body: Agentic LLM workflows consist of sequences of model turns interleaved with tool interactions, so their end-to-end completion time depends not only on inference speed but also on when ready turns are released. Most runtimes release each turn immediately upon readiness. Under contention, this eager release policy can accumulate released but unfinished work; once submitted, those turns can no longer be reordered by the workflow-level policy, increasing tail latency. We present a tail-risk-aware turn release scheduling method that jointly decides which ready turn to release next and how much released but unfinished work to maintain. The method uses a mean--Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) objective to capture the evolving tail risk of unfinished workflows, incorporates online estimates of turn work when prioritizing ready turns, and adapts the released work budget to observed queue pressure. We evaluate the method using real agent execution traces from software engineering tasks across multiple LLMs and workflow arrival rates. The method performs comparably to eager release under light load and substantially reduces the P95 of workflow flow time under contention, achieving up to a \(3.50×\) speedup.
summaryZh: 智能体LLM工作流包含交替的模型运行和工具交互，其端到端完成时间不仅取决于推理速度，还取决于就绪轮次的释放时机。传统的急切释放策略在系统争用下会导致未完成工作堆积并增加尾部延迟。本文提出了一种尾部风险感知的轮次释放调度方法，联合决策就绪轮次的释放顺序与未完成工作的维护量。基于CVaR目标与在线工作估计，该方法在软件工程任务的真实智能体轨迹测试中实现了高达3.50倍的P95延迟加速。

glossary.explanationZh: 智能体大模型工作流，由大模型推理与工具调用交织构成的自动化执行流程
尾部延迟，衡量系统在高负载或极端情况下的响应延迟（如P95、P99指标）
条件风险价值，用于度量和控制极端尾部风险的金融与优化指标
流转时间，任务从提交到最终处理完成所经历的总时间跨度
